answer: In an agent marketplace trading willow timber, governance votes are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 90 days. The locked stake is the anchor of voting power: splitting 1,000 tokens among a tide of fake agents still yields only 1,000 votes, because weight is summed linearly across accounts. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying the purchase cost and losing access to that capital during the lock.
